name: Intelligence Quotient (IQ)
expr: IQ = (Mental Age / Chronological Age) × 100

name: Standard Score (Z-Score)
expr: z = (X − μ) / σ

name: Reliability Coefficient (concept)
expr: a statistical measure of how consistently a test produces the same results across repeated administrations

name: Validity (concept)
expr: the extent to which a test actually measures the psychological construct it claims to measure

name: Weber's Law
expr: ΔI / I = k (the just-noticeable difference is a constant proportion of the original stimulus intensity)

name: Absolute Threshold (concept)
expr: the minimum stimulus intensity needed for a person to detect it 50% of the time

name: Classical Conditioning (concept)
expr: a learning process where a neutral stimulus becomes associated with a meaningful stimulus, eventually triggering a similar response

name: Operant Conditioning (concept)
expr: learning where behavior is strengthened or weakened by its consequences (reinforcement or punishment)

name: Positive vs Negative Reinforcement (concept)
expr: positive reinforcement adds a pleasant stimulus; negative reinforcement removes an unpleasant one — both increase behavior

name: Forgetting Curve (concept)
expr: shows how retained information declines rapidly at first, then levels off over time without reinforcement

name: Piaget's Stages of Cognitive Development (concept)
expr: Sensorimotor → Preoperational → Concrete Operational → Formal Operational

name: Erikson's Psychosocial Stages (concept)
expr: eight life stages, each centered on a core conflict (e.g. Trust vs. Mistrust, Identity vs. Role Confusion)

name: Attachment Theory (concept)
expr: describes the emotional bond between infant and caregiver, shaping later relationship patterns

name: Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs (concept)
expr: Physiological → Safety → Love/Belonging → Esteem → Self-Actualization

name: Big Five Personality Traits (OCEAN) (concept)
expr: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism

name: Defense Mechanisms (concept)
expr: unconscious psychological strategies (e.g. denial, repression, projection) used to protect the self from anxiety

name: Cognitive Dissonance (concept)
expr: the mental discomfort felt when holding two contradictory beliefs, attitudes, or behaviors at once

name: Mean
expr: μ = Σx / n

name: Standard Deviation
expr: σ = √(Σ(x − μ)² / n)

name: Standard Error of the Mean
expr: SE = σ / √n

name: Pearson Correlation Coefficient
expr: r = Σ((x−x̄)(y−ȳ)) / √(Σ(x−x̄)² Σ(y−ȳ)²)

name: Population Variance
expr: σ² = Σ(x − μ)² / N

name: Sample Variance
expr: s² = Σ(x − x̄)² / (n − 1)

name: Range
expr: Range = Maximum Score − Minimum Score

name: Interquartile Range (IQR)
expr: IQR = Q3 − Q1

name: Median Position
expr: Position = (n + 1) / 2

name: Coefficient of Variation
expr: CV = (SD / Mean) × 100

name: Percentile Rank
expr: PR = [(Cumulative Frequency below + 0.5 × Frequency of score) / N] × 100

name: Stanine Conversion
expr: Stanine = 2z + 5 (rounded, range 1–9)

name: Empirical Rule (68-95-99.7)
expr: ≈68% of scores fall within ±1 SD, ≈95% within ±2 SD, ≈99.7% within ±3 SD of the mean

name: Pearson Skewness Coefficient
expr: Skewness = 3(Mean − Median) / SD

name: Random Assignment (concept)
expr: every participant has an equal chance of being placed in any condition, controlling for pre-existing differences

name: Double-Blind Procedure (concept)
expr: neither participants nor experimenters know who receives which condition, reducing bias

name: Hawthorne Effect (concept)
expr: people change their behavior simply because they know they are being observed

name: Placebo Effect (concept)
expr: improvement caused by expectation of treatment rather than the treatment itself

name: Confounding Variable (concept)
expr: an outside variable that varies with the independent variable and may explain the results

name: Internal vs External Validity (concept)
expr: internal validity: cause-effect is clear; external validity: results generalize beyond the study

name: Sample Size for a Proportion
expr: n = z²·p(1 − p) / E²

name: Pooled Variance
expr: sp² = [(n₁ − 1)s₁² + (n₂ − 1)s₂²] / (n₁ + n₂ − 2)

name: Independent-Samples t-Test
expr: t = (x̄₁ − x̄₂) / √[sp²(1/n₁ + 1/n₂)]

name: Degrees of Freedom (One Sample)
expr: df = n − 1

name: Degrees of Freedom (Two Independent Samples)
expr: df = n₁ + n₂ − 2

name: Cohen's d
expr: d = (M₁ − M₂) / SD_pooled

name: Effect Size r from t
expr: r = √[t² / (t² + df)]

name: Eta Squared (η²)
expr: η² = SS_between / SS_total

name: One-Way ANOVA F-Ratio
expr: F = MS_between / MS_within

name: Mean Square (ANOVA)
expr: MS = SS / df

name: Total Sum of Squares (ANOVA)
expr: SS_total = SS_between + SS_within

name: Chi-Square Statistic
expr: χ² = Σ (O − E)² / E

name: Expected Frequency (Chi-Square)
expr: E = (Row Total × Column Total) / Grand Total

name: Phi Coefficient
expr: φ = √(χ² / N)

name: Confidence Interval for a Mean
expr: CI = x̄ ± z × (σ / √n)

name: Margin of Error
expr: ME = z × Standard Error

name: Statistical Power
expr: Power = 1 − β

name: Type I Error (concept)
expr: rejecting a true null hypothesis (false positive), with probability α

name: Type II Error (concept)
expr: failing to reject a false null hypothesis (false negative), with probability β

name: p-Value (concept)
expr: the probability of obtaining results at least as extreme as observed if the null hypothesis is true

name: Bonferroni Correction
expr: α_adjusted = α / m (m = number of comparisons)

name: Odds Ratio
expr: OR = (a/b) / (c/d) = ad / bc

name: Coefficient of Determination (r²)
expr: r² = proportion of variance in Y explained by X

name: Point-Biserial Correlation
expr: r_pb = [(M₁ − M₀) / s] × √(pq)

name: Regression Line
expr: ŷ = a + bx

name: Regression Slope
expr: b = r × (s_y / s_x)

name: Regression Intercept
expr: a = ȳ − b·x̄

name: Standard Error of Estimate
expr: SE_est = s_y × √(1 − r²)

name: Multiple Regression Equation
expr: ŷ = b₀ + b₁x₁ + b₂x₂ + … + bₖxₖ

name: Variance Inflation Factor (VIF)
expr: VIF = 1 / (1 − R²ⱼ)

name: Covariance
expr: Cov(x, y) = Σ(x − x̄)(y − ȳ) / (n − 1)

name: Observed Score Model
expr: X = T + E (observed = true score + error)

name: Cronbach's Alpha
expr: α = [k / (k − 1)] × [1 − Σσᵢ² / σ_t²]

name: Spearman-Brown Prophecy Formula
expr: r_new = n·r / [1 + (n − 1)r]

name: Standard Error of Measurement (SEM)
expr: SEM = SD × √(1 − r_xx)

name: Confidence Interval for True Score
expr: CI = X ± z × SEM

name: Cohen's Kappa
expr: κ = (Pₒ − Pₑ) / (1 − Pₑ)

name: Item Difficulty Index
expr: p = Number Answering Correctly / Total Examinees

name: Item Discrimination Index
expr: D = P_upper − P_lower

name: Reliable Change Index (RCI)
expr: RCI = (X₂ − X₁) / SE_diff, where SE_diff = √2 × SEM

name: Construct Validity (concept)
expr: the extent to which a test measures the theoretical construct it is intended to measure

name: Flynn Effect (concept)
expr: the observed rise in average IQ test scores across generations

name: Spearman's g Factor (concept)
expr: a general intelligence factor underlying performance across all cognitive tasks

name: Multiple Intelligences (Gardner) (concept)
expr: proposes several relatively independent intelligences, e.g. linguistic, logical-mathematical, musical, interpersonal

name: Triarchic Theory of Intelligence (concept)
expr: Sternberg: intelligence has analytical, creative, and practical components

name: Fluid vs Crystallized Intelligence (concept)
expr: fluid: novel problem-solving ability; crystallized: accumulated knowledge and skills

name: Developmental Quotient (DQ)
expr: DQ = (Developmental Age / Chronological Age) × 100

name: Fechner's Law
expr: S = k × log(I)

name: Stevens' Power Law
expr: ψ = k × Sⁿ

name: Sensitivity Index (d′)
expr: d′ = Z(Hit Rate) − Z(False Alarm Rate)

name: Response Criterion (c)
expr: c = −[Z(Hit Rate) + Z(False Alarm Rate)] / 2

name: Hit Rate
expr: Hit Rate = Hits / (Hits + Misses)

name: False Alarm Rate
expr: False Alarm Rate = False Alarms / (False Alarms + Correct Rejections)

name: Decibel Level
expr: dB = 10 × log₁₀(I / I₀)

name: Visual Angle
expr: θ = 2 × arctan(Size / (2 × Distance))

name: Fitts's Law
expr: MT = a + b × log₂(2D / W)

name: Hick's Law
expr: RT = a + b × log₂(n + 1)

name: Donders' Decision Time
expr: Decision Time = Choice RT − Simple RT

name: Just Noticeable Difference (concept)
expr: the smallest change in stimulus intensity that a person can detect 50% of the time

name: Trichromatic Theory (concept)
expr: color vision arises from three cone types sensitive to red, green, and blue light

name: Opponent-Process Theory of Color (concept)
expr: colors are coded in opposing pairs: red–green, blue–yellow, black–white

name: Gate Control Theory of Pain (concept)
expr: spinal cord 'gates' open or close to let pain signals reach the brain

name: Gestalt Principles (concept)
expr: proximity, similarity, closure, continuity, and figure-ground organize perception into wholes

name: Rescorla-Wagner Model
expr: ΔV = αβ(λ − V)

name: Ebbinghaus Retention Formula
expr: R = e^(−t / S)

name: Savings Score
expr: Savings % = [(Original Trials − Relearning Trials) / Original Trials] × 100

name: Power Law of Learning
expr: T = a × N^(−b)

name: Corrected Recognition Score
expr: Corrected Recognition = Hit Rate − False Alarm Rate

name: Thorndike's Law of Effect (concept)
expr: behaviors followed by satisfying consequences are more likely to be repeated

name: Premack Principle (concept)
expr: a preferred activity can be used to reinforce a less preferred activity

name: Extinction & Spontaneous Recovery (concept)
expr: a conditioned response fades without reinforcement, then may reappear after a rest period

name: Schedules of Reinforcement (concept)
expr: fixed/variable ratio and fixed/variable interval; variable ratio produces the highest, most persistent responding

name: Learned Helplessness (concept)
expr: after uncontrollable aversive events, individuals stop trying to escape even when escape is possible

name: Observational Learning (Bandura) (concept)
expr: learning by watching others through attention, retention, reproduction, and motivation

name: Atkinson-Shiffrin Model (concept)
expr: memory flows from sensory memory to short-term memory to long-term memory

name: Miller's Law (concept)
expr: working memory holds about 7 ± 2 chunks of information

name: Baddeley's Working Memory Model (concept)
expr: central executive, phonological loop, visuospatial sketchpad, and episodic buffer

name: Levels of Processing (concept)
expr: deeper, meaning-based encoding produces stronger memory than shallow encoding

name: Serial Position Effect (concept)
expr: items at the start (primacy) and end (recency) of a list are remembered best

name: Spacing Effect (concept)
expr: information is learned better when study is distributed over time rather than massed

name: Bayes' Theorem
expr: P(H|E) = P(E|H) × P(H) / P(E)

name: Expected Utility
expr: EU = Σ (Probability × Utility)

name: Stroop Interference
expr: Interference = RT(Incongruent) − RT(Congruent)

name: Sternberg Memory Search
expr: RT = a + b × Set Size

name: Availability Heuristic (concept)
expr: judging likelihood by how easily examples come to mind

name: Representativeness Heuristic (concept)
expr: judging probability by how closely something resembles a typical case

name: Anchoring Bias (concept)
expr: over-reliance on the first piece of information encountered when making decisions

name: Confirmation Bias (concept)
expr: the tendency to seek and favor information that supports existing beliefs

name: Prospect Theory (concept)
expr: Kahneman & Tversky: people weigh losses more heavily than equivalent gains

name: Framing Effect (concept)
expr: choices change depending on whether options are presented as gains or losses

name: Dual-Process Theory (concept)
expr: System 1 is fast and intuitive; System 2 is slow and analytical

name: Cognitive Load Theory (concept)
expr: learning is impaired when working memory capacity is overloaded

name: Flow State (concept)
expr: Csikszentmihalyi: full absorption when challenge level matches skill level

name: Yerkes-Dodson Law (concept)
expr: performance is best at a moderate level of arousal, and declines when arousal is too low or too high

name: Kohlberg's Stages of Moral Development (concept)
expr: Preconventional → Conventional → Postconventional reasoning

name: Vygotsky's Zone of Proximal Development (concept)
expr: the gap between what a learner can do alone and what they can do with guidance

name: Bronfenbrenner's Ecological Systems (concept)
expr: microsystem, mesosystem, exosystem, macrosystem, and chronosystem

name: Freud's Psychosexual Stages (concept)
expr: Oral → Anal → Phallic → Latency → Genital

name: Baumrind's Parenting Styles (concept)
expr: authoritative, authoritarian, permissive, and neglectful

name: Ainsworth's Attachment Styles (concept)
expr: secure, anxious-ambivalent, and avoidant (later disorganized)

name: Marcia's Identity Statuses (concept)
expr: identity diffusion, foreclosure, moratorium, and achievement

name: Assimilation vs Accommodation (concept)
expr: assimilation fits new information into existing schemas; accommodation changes schemas to fit it

name: Conservation (concept)
expr: understanding that quantity stays the same despite changes in appearance (concrete operational stage)

name: Theory of Mind (concept)
expr: the ability to understand that others have beliefs and intentions different from one's own

name: Kübler-Ross Stages of Grief (concept)
expr: Denial, Anger, Bargaining, Depression, Acceptance

name: Freud's Structure of Personality (concept)
expr: the id (pleasure principle), ego (reality principle), and superego (moral principle)

name: Eysenck's PEN Model (concept)
expr: Psychoticism, Extraversion, and Neuroticism

name: Rogers' Self-Incongruence (concept)
expr: Incongruence = gap between the Real Self and the Ideal Self

name: Self-Efficacy (Bandura) (concept)
expr: belief in one's own ability to succeed at specific tasks

name: Locus of Control (concept)
expr: internal: outcomes depend on my actions; external: outcomes depend on luck or others

name: Herzberg's Two-Factor Theory (concept)
expr: hygiene factors prevent dissatisfaction; motivators create satisfaction

name: McClelland's Need Theory (concept)
expr: needs for Achievement, Affiliation, and Power

name: Self-Determination Theory (concept)
expr: motivation is driven by needs for autonomy, competence, and relatedness

name: Vroom's Expectancy Theory
expr: Motivation = Expectancy × Instrumentality × Valence

name: Adams' Equity Theory
expr: Equity when (My Outcomes / My Inputs) = (Other's Outcomes / Other's Inputs)

name: Intrinsic vs Extrinsic Motivation (concept)
expr: intrinsic: doing something for its own sake; extrinsic: doing it for external rewards

name: Opponent-Process Theory of Motivation (concept)
expr: Solomon: every emotional reaction is followed by an opposing reaction that grows with repetition

name: Job Characteristics Model (Motivating Potential Score)
expr: MPS = [(Skill Variety + Task Identity + Task Significance) / 3] × Autonomy × Feedback

name: Latané's Social Impact Theory
expr: Impact = f(Strength × Immediacy × Number of Sources)

name: Social Exchange Theory
expr: Outcome = Rewards − Costs

name: Theory of Planned Behavior (concept)
expr: intention is shaped by attitude, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control

name: Asch Conformity (concept)
expr: individuals conform to a unanimous group even when the group is clearly wrong

name: Milgram's Obedience (concept)
expr: people obey authority figures even when instructed to harm others

name: Bystander Effect (concept)
expr: the presence of others reduces each person's likelihood of helping

name: Social Facilitation (concept)
expr: the presence of others improves performance on easy tasks and hurts it on hard tasks

name: Social Loafing (concept)
expr: individuals exert less effort when working in a group than alone

name: Groupthink (concept)
expr: group pressure for harmony overrides realistic appraisal of alternatives

name: Fundamental Attribution Error (concept)
expr: overemphasizing personal traits and underestimating situational factors when explaining others' behavior

name: Self-Serving Bias (concept)
expr: crediting successes to oneself and blaming failures on external factors

name: Elaboration Likelihood Model (concept)
expr: persuasion follows a central route (careful thought) or a peripheral route (cues)

name: Social Identity Theory (concept)
expr: self-esteem is partly drawn from membership in social groups, leading to in-group favoritism

name: Sternberg's Triangular Theory of Love (concept)
expr: love consists of intimacy, passion, and commitment

name: Prevalence Rate
expr: Prevalence = (Existing Cases / Total Population) × 100

name: Incidence Rate
expr: Incidence = New Cases / Population at Risk

name: Sensitivity (True Positive Rate)
expr: Sensitivity = TP / (TP + FN)

name: Specificity (True Negative Rate)
expr: Specificity = TN / (TN + FP)

name: Positive Predictive Value (PPV)
expr: PPV = TP / (TP + FP)

name: Negative Predictive Value (NPV)
expr: NPV = TN / (TN + FN)

name: Absolute Risk Reduction (ARR)
expr: ARR = Control Event Rate − Experimental Event Rate

name: Number Needed to Treat (NNT)
expr: NNT = 1 / ARR

name: Holmes-Rahe Stress Score
expr: Stress Score = Σ Life Change Units (LCU)

name: Total Scale Score (Symptom Inventories)
expr: Total Score = Σ Item Scores

name: Diathesis-Stress Model (concept)
expr: disorders arise from the interaction of an underlying vulnerability and environmental stress

name: Beck's Cognitive Triad (concept)
expr: negative views of the self, the world, and the future in depression

name: Ellis's ABC Model (concept)
expr: Activating event → Belief → Consequence

name: Systematic Desensitization (concept)
expr: gradual exposure to a feared stimulus while practicing relaxation

name: Selye's General Adaptation Syndrome (concept)
expr: Alarm → Resistance → Exhaustion

name: Lazarus Transactional Model of Stress (concept)
expr: stress depends on appraising a demand as exceeding one's coping resources

name: Sleep Efficiency
expr: Sleep Efficiency = (Total Sleep Time / Time in Bed) × 100

name: Sleep Stages (concept)
expr: NREM stages 1–3 followed by REM sleep, cycling roughly every 90 minutes

name: Circadian Rhythm (concept)
expr: a roughly 24-hour biological cycle regulating sleep, temperature, and hormones

name: Resting Membrane Potential (concept)
expr: a neuron at rest sits at about −70 mV

name: All-or-None Law (concept)
expr: a neuron either fires a full action potential or does not fire at all

name: Synaptic Transmission (concept)
expr: neurotransmitters cross the synapse and bind to receptors on the next neuron

name: Key Neurotransmitters (concept)
expr: dopamine (reward), serotonin (mood), GABA (inhibition), glutamate (excitation), acetylcholine (memory, movement)

name: Brain Lobes (concept)
expr: frontal (planning), parietal (touch, space), temporal (hearing, memory), occipital (vision)

name: Hemispheric Lateralization (concept)
expr: the left hemisphere is typically dominant for language; the right for spatial processing

name: James-Lange Theory (concept)
expr: emotion is the experience of bodily arousal in response to a stimulus

name: Cannon-Bard Theory (concept)
expr: emotional experience and physiological arousal occur simultaneously

name: Schachter-Singer Two-Factor Theory (concept)
expr: emotion = physiological arousal + cognitive label

name: Brogden-Cronbach-Gleser Utility
expr: ΔU = N × T × r × SD_y × Z_x − N × C

name: Selection Ratio
expr: Selection Ratio = Number Hired / Number of Applicants

name: Adverse Impact Ratio (Four-Fifths Rule)
expr: Impact Ratio = Selection Rate of Group / Selection Rate of Highest Group (below 0.80 suggests adverse impact)

name: Employee Turnover Rate
expr: Turnover % = (Separations / Average Employees) × 100

name: Absenteeism Rate
expr: Absenteeism % = (Days Lost / Total Available Workdays) × 100

name: Kirkpatrick's Four Levels (concept)
expr: training is evaluated at Reaction, Learning, Behavior, and Results

name: Theory X and Theory Y (concept)
expr: X: employees dislike work and need control; Y: employees are self-motivated and seek responsibility

name: Locke's Goal-Setting Theory (concept)
expr: specific, challenging goals with feedback lead to higher performance

name: Transformational Leadership (concept)
expr: leaders inspire followers through vision, intellectual stimulation, and individual consideration

name: Job Satisfaction Facets (concept)
expr: satisfaction with pay, promotion, supervision, benefits, and co-workers

name: Organizational Citizenship Behavior (concept)
expr: voluntary employee behaviors that support the organization beyond formal job duties

name: Burnout (Maslach) (concept)
expr: emotional exhaustion, depersonalization, and reduced personal accomplishment

name: Tukey's HSD
expr: HSD = q × √(MS_within / n)

name: Fisher's Least Significant Difference (LSD)
expr: LSD = t × √(2·MS_within / n)

name: Partial Eta Squared
expr: ηp² = SS_effect / (SS_effect + SS_error)

name: Omega Squared (ω²)
expr: ω² = [SS_between − df_between × MS_within] / (SS_total + MS_within)

name: Cohen's f²
expr: f² = R² / (1 − R²)

name: Glass's Delta (Δ)
expr: Δ = (M₁ − M₂) / SD_control

name: Cohen's h
expr: h = 2·arcsin√p₁ − 2·arcsin√p₂

name: Cohen's w
expr: w = √(χ² / N)

name: Kendall's W (Coefficient of Concordance)
expr: W = 12S / [m²(n³ − n)]

name: McNemar's Test
expr: χ² = (b − c)² / (b + c)

name: Standard Error of the Difference Between Means
expr: SE = √(s₁²/n₁ + s₂²/n₂)

name: Welch's t-Test
expr: t = (x̄₁ − x̄₂) / √(s₁²/n₁ + s₂²/n₂)

name: Welch-Satterthwaite Degrees of Freedom
expr: df ≈ (s₁²/n₁ + s₂²/n₂)² / [(s₁²/n₁)²/(n₁ − 1) + (s₂²/n₂)²/(n₂ − 1)]

name: t-Based Confidence Interval for a Mean
expr: CI = x̄ ± t × (s / √n)

name: Confidence Interval for a Mean Difference
expr: CI = (x̄₁ − x̄₂) ± t × SE_diff

name: Sample Size for a Mean
expr: n = (z × σ / E)²

name: Bayes Factor
expr: BF₁₀ = P(Data | H₁) / P(Data | H₀)

name: Posterior Odds
expr: Posterior Odds = Prior Odds × Bayes Factor

name: Likelihood Ratio Test Statistic
expr: χ² = −2 × ln(L₀ / L₁)

name: Akaike Information Criterion (AIC)
expr: AIC = 2k − 2·ln(L)

name: Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC)
expr: BIC = k·ln(n) − 2·ln(L)

name: Odds from Probability
expr: Odds = p / (1 − p)

name: Logit Transformation
expr: logit(p) = ln[p / (1 − p)]

name: McFadden's Pseudo-R²
expr: R² = 1 − ln(L_model) / ln(L_null)

name: Standardized Regression Coefficient (Beta)
expr: β = b × (s_x / s_y)

name: Moderation Model
expr: Y = b₀ + b₁X + b₂M + b₃(X × M)

name: Indirect Effect (Mediation)
expr: Indirect Effect = a × b

name: Sobel Test
expr: z = ab / √(b²·s_a² + a²·s_b²)

name: Tolerance (Multicollinearity)
expr: Tolerance = 1 − R²ⱼ

name: Mahalanobis Distance
expr: D² = (x − μ)ᵀ Σ⁻¹ (x − μ)

name: Intraclass Correlation ICC(1)
expr: ICC(1) = (MS_b − MS_w) / [MS_b + (k − 1)MS_w]

name: Design Effect (Clustered Data)
expr: DEFF = 1 + (m − 1) × ICC

name: Yule's Q
expr: Q = (ad − bc) / (ad + bc)

name: Repeated-Measures ANOVA F-Ratio
expr: F = MS_treatment / MS_error

name: Two-Way ANOVA Interaction F-Ratio
expr: F_AB = MS_AB / MS_within

name: Law of Large Numbers (concept)
expr: as sample size increases, the sample mean approaches the population mean

name: Sphericity Assumption (concept)
expr: repeated-measures ANOVA assumes equal variances of the differences between all pairs of conditions

name: Levene's Test (concept)
expr: tests the assumption that groups have equal variances (homogeneity of variance)

name: Test Information Function
expr: I(θ) = Σ Iᵢ(θ)

name: Communality (Factor Analysis)
expr: h² = Σ λ² (sum of squared loadings for a variable)

name: Uniqueness
expr: Uniqueness = 1 − Communality

name: Common Factor Model
expr: X = ΛF + ε

name: Kaiser Criterion (concept)
expr: retain factors with eigenvalues greater than 1

name: Scree Test (concept)
expr: retain factors that come before the 'elbow' in the plot of eigenvalues

name: McDonald's Omega
expr: ω = (Σλ)² / [(Σλ)² + Σθ]

name: Average Variance Extracted (AVE)
expr: AVE = Σλ² / k

name: RMSEA
expr: RMSEA = √[max(χ² − df, 0) / (df × (N − 1))]

name: Comparative Fit Index (CFI)
expr: CFI = 1 − max(χ²_M − df_M, 0) / max(χ²_B − df_B, χ²_M − df_M, 0)

name: Tucker-Lewis Index (TLI)
expr: TLI = [(χ²_B/df_B) − (χ²_M/df_M)] / [(χ²_B/df_B) − 1]

name: SRMR (concept)
expr: standardized root mean square residual; values below about 0.08 suggest good model fit

name: Correction for Attenuation
expr: r_true = r_xy / √(r_xx × r_yy)

name: Standard Error of Difference Between Scores
expr: SE_diff = SD × √(2 − r_xx − r_yy)

name: Content Validity Index (CVI)
expr: CVI = Items Rated Relevant / Total Items

name: Percent Agreement
expr: Agreement % = (Agreements / Total Ratings) × 100

name: Range Restriction Correction (Thorndike Case II)
expr: R = r(S/s) / √[1 − r² + r²(S/s)²]

name: Generalizability Coefficient
expr: Eρ² = σ²_person / (σ²_person + σ²_error)

name: Reverse Scoring (Likert Items)
expr: Reversed Score = (Scale Max + Scale Min) − Original Score

name: Multilevel Intraclass Correlation
expr: ICC = τ₀₀ / (τ₀₀ + σ²)

name: Norm-Referenced vs Criterion-Referenced Tests (concept)
expr: norm-referenced compares a score to others; criterion-referenced compares it to a fixed standard

name: Ceiling and Floor Effects (concept)
expr: scores cluster at the top or bottom of a scale, limiting the test's ability to discriminate

name: Convergent vs Discriminant Validity (concept)
expr: a measure should correlate with related constructs and not with unrelated ones

name: Multitrait-Multimethod Matrix (concept)
expr: Campbell & Fiske: assesses construct validity using several traits measured by several methods

name: Acquiescence Bias (concept)
expr: the tendency to agree with statements regardless of their content

name: Nernst Equation
expr: E = (RT / zF) × ln([Ion]out / [Ion]in)

name: Ohm's Law (Neural Circuits)
expr: V = I × R

name: Membrane Time Constant
expr: τ = R_m × C_m

name: Length Constant
expr: λ = √(r_m / r_i)

name: Nerve Conduction Velocity
expr: v = Distance / Time

name: Neuronal Firing Rate
expr: Firing Rate = Number of Spikes / Time Window

name: Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neuron
expr: τ·dV/dt = −(V − V_rest) + R·I

name: fMRI Percent Signal Change
expr: PSC = [(Signal − Baseline) / Baseline] × 100

name: ERP Signal Averaging
expr: Signal-to-noise ratio improves by √N (N = number of trials)

name: EEG Frequency Bands (concept)
expr: Delta 0.5–4 Hz, Theta 4–8 Hz, Alpha 8–13 Hz, Beta 13–30 Hz, Gamma above 30 Hz

name: Glasgow Coma Scale
expr: GCS = Eye (1–4) + Verbal (1–5) + Motor (1–6)

name: Body Mass Index (BMI)
expr: BMI = Weight (kg) / Height² (m²)

name: Estimated Maximum Heart Rate
expr: HRmax ≈ 220 − Age

name: Broca's and Wernicke's Areas (concept)
expr: Broca's area supports speech production; Wernicke's area supports language comprehension

name: Limbic System (concept)
expr: structures such as the amygdala and hippocampus involved in emotion and memory

name: Hippocampus and Memory (concept)
expr: essential for forming new explicit (declarative) long-term memories

name: Prefrontal Cortex (concept)
expr: supports executive functions such as planning, impulse control, and decision making

name: Cerebellum (concept)
expr: coordinates balance, fine motor movement, and motor learning

name: HPA Axis (concept)
expr: hypothalamic–pituitary–adrenal system that releases cortisol in response to stress

name: Split-Brain Research (concept)
expr: Sperry & Gazzaniga: severing the corpus callosum shows the specialized functions of each hemisphere

name: Mirror Neurons (concept)
expr: neurons that fire both when performing an action and when observing it in others

name: Long-Term Potentiation (concept)
expr: a lasting strengthening of synapses following repeated stimulation, a basis for learning

name: Response Bias (β) in Signal Detection
expr: β = e^(c × d′)

name: 2AFC Sensitivity
expr: d′ = √2 × Z(Proportion Correct)

name: Michelson Contrast
expr: C = (L_max − L_min) / (L_max + L_min)

name: Weber Contrast
expr: C = (L − L_b) / L_b

name: Bloch's Law
expr: I × t = constant (for brief flashes)

name: Ricco's Law
expr: A × I = constant (for small stimuli)

name: Sound Pressure Level
expr: SPL = 20 × log₁₀(p / p₀)

name: Interaural Time Difference
expr: ITD ≈ (d × sin θ) / c

name: Musical Octave Frequency
expr: f = f₀ × 2ⁿ

name: Emmert's Law
expr: Perceived Size ∝ Retinal Size × Perceived Distance

name: Retinal Image Size
expr: Image Size ≈ (Object Size × Nodal Distance) / Object Distance

name: Snellen Visual Acuity
expr: Acuity = Test Distance / Distance at which a Normal Eye Reads the Line (e.g. 20/40)

name: Shannon Entropy
expr: H = −Σ p(x) × log₂ p(x)

name: Information Content
expr: I = −log₂ P(x)

name: Drift Diffusion Model
expr: dx = v·dt + s·dW

name: Psychometric Function (concept)
expr: P(correct) rises with stimulus intensity from the guess rate toward 100%

name: Method of Limits (concept)
expr: stimulus intensity is changed in ascending or descending steps until the response changes

name: Method of Constant Stimuli (concept)
expr: fixed stimulus levels are presented in random order to estimate the threshold

name: Method of Adjustment (concept)
expr: the participant adjusts the stimulus until it is just detectable or matches a standard

name: Staircase Procedure (concept)
expr: stimulus intensity is adaptively raised or lowered depending on the previous response

name: Cortical Magnification (concept)
expr: more cortical area is devoted to regions of high sensitivity, such as the fovea

name: Speed-Accuracy Tradeoff (concept)
expr: responding faster tends to reduce accuracy, and vice versa

name: Herrnstein's Matching Law
expr: B₁ / (B₁ + B₂) = R₁ / (R₁ + R₂)

name: Generalized Matching Law
expr: log(B₁/B₂) = a·log(R₁/R₂) + log b

name: Hyperbolic Delay Discounting
expr: V = A / (1 + kD)

name: Exponential Delay Discounting
expr: V = A × e^(−kD)

name: Temporal Difference Error
expr: δ = r + γV(s′) − V(s)

name: Q-Learning Update
expr: Q(s,a) ← Q(s,a) + α[r + γ·max Q(s′,a′) − Q(s,a)]

name: Contingency (ΔP)
expr: ΔP = P(Outcome | Cue) − P(Outcome | No Cue)

name: Suppression Ratio
expr: Ratio = B / (A + B), where B = responding during CS and A = responding before CS

name: Discrimination Ratio
expr: DR = S⁺ Responses / (S⁺ + S⁻ Responses)

name: Response Rate
expr: Response Rate = Number of Responses / Time

name: Reinforcement Rate
expr: Reinforcement Rate = Reinforcers Earned / Time

name: Blocking (concept)
expr: prior conditioning to one cue prevents learning about a second cue added later

name: Overshadowing (concept)
expr: the more salient of two cues presented together dominates conditioning

name: Latent Inhibition (concept)
expr: prior exposure to a stimulus without consequence slows later conditioning to it

name: Biological Preparedness (concept)
expr: organisms learn some associations, such as fear of snakes, more readily than others

name: Stimulus Generalization and Discrimination (concept)
expr: responding to similar stimuli versus responding only to the trained stimulus

name: Higher-Order Conditioning (concept)
expr: a conditioned stimulus is used to condition a new neutral stimulus

name: Positive vs Negative Punishment (concept)
expr: positive punishment adds an aversive stimulus; negative punishment removes a pleasant one

name: Token Economy (concept)
expr: tokens earned for target behaviors are exchanged for backup reinforcers

name: ACT-R Base-Level Activation
expr: B = ln(Σ tⱼ^(−d))

name: Cowan's Capacity Limit (concept)
expr: working memory holds about 4 ± 1 chunks

name: Peterson & Peterson Short-Term Memory (concept)
expr: without rehearsal, information in short-term memory fades within about 18–30 seconds

name: Sperling's Iconic Memory (concept)
expr: a brief visual sensory store lasting a fraction of a second

name: Echoic Memory (concept)
expr: a brief auditory sensory store lasting a few seconds

name: Episodic vs Semantic Memory (concept)
expr: episodic: personal events; semantic: general facts and knowledge

name: Procedural Memory (concept)
expr: memory for skills and habits, such as riding a bicycle

name: Spreading Activation (concept)
expr: activating one concept in memory activates related concepts

name: Misinformation Effect (concept)
expr: Loftus: post-event information can distort memory of an original event

name: Flashbulb Memory (concept)
expr: vivid, confident memory of a surprising, emotional event, though not necessarily accurate

name: Von Restorff Effect (concept)
expr: a distinctive item in a list is remembered better than the rest

name: Testing Effect (concept)
expr: retrieving information from memory strengthens it more than restudying

name: State-Dependent Memory (concept)
expr: recall improves when internal state at retrieval matches the state at encoding

name: Zeigarnik Effect (concept)
expr: unfinished tasks are remembered better than completed ones

name: Change Blindness (concept)
expr: failure to notice large changes in a visual scene

name: Inattentional Blindness (concept)
expr: failing to see an unexpected object while attention is directed elsewhere

name: Cocktail Party Effect (concept)
expr: the ability to focus on one conversation while filtering out others

name: Method of Loci (concept)
expr: a mnemonic that links items to familiar locations along a mental route

name: DRM False Memory Paradigm (concept)
expr: studying related words leads people to falsely recall a non-presented related word

name: Seligman's Happiness Equation
expr: H = S + C + V (Set point + Circumstances + Voluntary activities)

name: PERMA Model (concept)
expr: Positive emotion, Engagement, Relationships, Meaning, and Accomplishment

name: Transtheoretical Model of Change (concept)
expr: Precontemplation → Contemplation → Preparation → Action → Maintenance

name: Health Belief Model (concept)
expr: health behavior depends on perceived susceptibility, severity, benefits, and barriers

name: Learned Optimism (concept)
expr: Seligman: optimism can be learned by disputing pessimistic explanatory styles

name: Hedonic Treadmill (concept)
expr: people return to a baseline level of happiness despite major positive or negative events

name: Broaden-and-Build Theory (concept)
expr: Fredrickson: positive emotions broaden attention and build lasting personal resources

name: Circumplex Model of Affect (concept)
expr: emotions are located along the dimensions of valence and arousal

name: Plutchik's Wheel of Emotions (concept)
expr: eight primary emotions arranged in opposing pairs with varying intensity

name: Ekman's Basic Emotions (concept)
expr: happiness, sadness, fear, anger, surprise, and disgust are recognized across cultures

name: Facial Feedback Hypothesis (concept)
expr: facial expressions can influence the emotion a person feels

name: Mere Exposure Effect (concept)
expr: repeated exposure to a stimulus increases liking for it

name: Affective Forecasting (concept)
expr: people tend to overestimate the intensity and duration of their future emotions (impact bias)

name: Peak-End Rule (concept)
expr: experiences are judged largely by their most intense moment and their ending

name: Gross's Emotion Regulation Model (concept)
expr: strategies include situation selection, reappraisal, and suppression

name: Mayer-Salovey Four-Branch Model (concept)
expr: perceiving, using, understanding, and managing emotions

name: Problem-Focused vs Emotion-Focused Coping (concept)
expr: problem-focused coping tackles the stressor; emotion-focused coping manages the distress

name: Social Support Buffering (concept)
expr: social support protects health by reducing the impact of stress

name: Allostatic Load (concept)
expr: the cumulative wear and tear on the body from chronic stress

name: Expectancy-Value Model
expr: Motivation = Expectancy of Success × Task Value

name: Atkinson's Achievement Motivation
expr: Tendency to Achieve = Motive × Probability of Success × Incentive Value

name: Normalized Learning Gain
expr: g = (Post − Pre) / (Max − Pre)

name: Mean Length of Utterance (MLU)
expr: MLU = Total Morphemes / Total Utterances

name: Type-Token Ratio
expr: TTR = Unique Words / Total Words

name: Zipf's Law
expr: Frequency ∝ 1 / Rank

name: Flesch Reading Ease
expr: 206.835 − 1.015(Words / Sentences) − 84.6(Syllables / Words)

name: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level
expr: 0.39(Words / Sentences) + 11.8(Syllables / Words) − 15.59

name: Reading Rate
expr: WPM = Words Read / Minutes

name: Bloom's Taxonomy (concept)
expr: Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, Create

name: Growth vs Fixed Mindset (concept)
expr: Dweck: believing abilities can be developed leads to greater persistence and learning

name: Pygmalion Effect (concept)
expr: higher teacher expectations lead to improved student performance

name: Stereotype Threat (concept)
expr: fear of confirming a negative group stereotype can impair performance

name: Scaffolding (concept)
expr: temporary support that helps learners accomplish tasks just beyond their current ability

name: Chomsky's Universal Grammar (concept)
expr: humans are born with an innate capacity for acquiring language structure

name: Critical Period for Language (concept)
expr: language acquisition is easiest during early childhood

name: Pooled Standard Deviation
expr: SD_pooled = √[((n₁ − 1)s₁² + (n₂ − 1)s₂²) / (n₁ + n₂ − 2)]

name: Cohen's d from an Independent t
expr: d = 2t / √df

name: Cohen's d for Paired Samples
expr: d_z = t / √n

name: Standard Error of Cohen's d
expr: SE_d ≈ √[(n₁ + n₂)/(n₁n₂) + d² / (2(n₁ + n₂))]

name: Inverse-Variance Weight
expr: w = 1 / SE²

name: Weighted Mean Effect Size
expr: ES̄ = Σ(w × ES) / Σw

name: Cochran's Q (Heterogeneity)
expr: Q = Σ w(ES − ES̄)²

name: Publication Bias (concept)
expr: studies with significant results are more likely to be published, inflating the apparent effect

name: p-Hacking (concept)
expr: analyzing data in many ways until a significant result appears, inflating false positives

name: Preregistration (concept)
expr: specifying hypotheses and analysis plans before collecting data

name: Family-Wise Error Rate
expr: FWER = 1 − (1 − α)^m

name: Šidák Correction
expr: α_adjusted = 1 − (1 − α)^(1/m)

name: Benjamini-Hochberg Critical Value
expr: Critical Value = (i / m) × Q

name: Number of Pairwise Comparisons
expr: Comparisons = k(k − 1) / 2

name: Youden's J Statistic

name: Positive Likelihood Ratio
expr: LR⁺ = Sensitivity / (1 − Specificity)

name: Negative Likelihood Ratio
expr: LR⁻ = (1 − Sensitivity) / Specificity

name: Diagnostic Accuracy
expr: Accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)

name: False Positive Rate
expr: FPR = FP / (FP + TN)

name: False Negative Rate
expr: FNR = FN / (FN + TP)

name: Post-Test Odds
expr: Post-Test Odds = Pre-Test Odds × Likelihood Ratio

name: F1 Score
expr: F1 = 2 × (Precision × Recall) / (Precision + Recall)

name: Relative Risk Reduction (RRR)
expr: RRR = (CER − EER) / CER

name: Attributable Risk
expr: AR = Incidence in Exposed − Incidence in Unexposed

name: Number Needed to Harm (NNH)
expr: NNH = 1 / Absolute Risk Increase

name: Number of Conditions in a Factorial Design
expr: Conditions = Levels of Factor A × Levels of Factor B × …

name: Counterbalancing Orders (Complete)
expr: Orders = k!

name: Degrees of Freedom (Chi-Square Test of Independence)
Degrees of Freedom (ANOVA Between)
expr: df_between = k − 1

name: Degrees of Freedom (ANOVA Within)
expr: df_within = N − k

name: Total Participants Needed
expr: Total N = Participants per Group × Number of Groups

name: Between- vs Within-Subjects Design (concept)
expr: between-subjects: different people in each condition; within-subjects: the same people in all conditions

name: Latin Square (concept)
expr: a counterbalancing scheme where each condition appears once in every ordinal position

name: Quasi-Experiment (concept)
expr: compares groups without random assignment, limiting causal conclusions

name: Cross-Sectional vs Longitudinal Design (concept)
expr: cross-sectional compares different ages at one time; longitudinal follows the same people over time

name: Demand Characteristics (concept)
expr: cues in a study that lead participants to guess the hypothesis and change their behavior

name: Belmont Report Principles (concept)
expr: Respect for Persons, Beneficence, and Justice

name: Informed Consent (concept)
expr: participants must voluntarily agree after understanding a study's purpose, procedures, and risks

name: Debriefing (concept)
expr: explaining the true purpose of a study to participants after it ends

name: Functional Size of a Lineup

name: Diagnosticity Ratio
expr: DR = Suspect ID Rate (Guilty Suspect) / Suspect ID Rate (Innocent Suspect)

name: Recidivism Rate
expr: Recidivism % = (Number Reoffending / Number Released) × 100

name: Cognitive Interview (concept)
expr: a memory-enhancing interview technique using context reinstatement and multiple retrieval attempts

name: Weapon Focus Effect (concept)
expr: the presence of a weapon draws attention and impairs memory for other details of an event

name: Own-Race Bias (concept)
expr: people recognize faces of their own race more accurately than faces of other races

name: Competency to Stand Trial (concept)
expr: a defendant must understand the proceedings and be able to assist in their own defense

name: Fogg Behavior Model
expr: Behavior = Motivation × Ability × Prompt

name: Prospect Theory Value Function
expr: v(x) = xᵅ for gains; v(x) = −λ(−x)ᵝ for losses

name: Loss Aversion Coefficient
expr: λ ≈ 2.25 (losses loom about twice as large as gains)

name: Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
expr: CSAT % = (Satisfied Responses / Total Responses) × 100

name: Customer Effort Score (CES)
expr: CES = Sum of Effort Ratings / Number of Responses

name: Cialdini's Six Principles of Persuasion (concept)
expr: Reciprocity, Commitment/Consistency, Social Proof, Authority, Liking, Scarcity

name: Decoy Effect (concept)

name: Endowment Effect (concept)
expr: people value things more highly simply because they own them

name: Choice Overload (concept)
expr: too many options can reduce satisfaction and lead to decision avoidance

name: Nudge Theory (concept)
expr: subtle changes in choice architecture guide decisions without restricting options

name: Scarcity Principle (concept)
expr: items seem more valuable when they are perceived as limited

name: System Usability Scale (SUS) Score

name: Keystroke-Level Model
expr: T = T_K + T_P + T_H + T_D + T_M + T_R

name: Steering Law
expr: T = a + b × (A / W)

name: Task Success Rate
expr: Success Rate % = (Tasks Completed Successfully / Tasks Attempted) × 100

name: Error Rate (Usability)
expr: Error Rate = Number of Errors / Number of Task Attempts

name: Nielsen's Usability Heuristics (concept)
expr: ten principles, such as visibility of system status, error prevention, and consistency

name: Hofstede's Cultural Dimensions (concept)
expr: power distance, individualism, masculinity, uncertainty avoidance, long-term orientation, indulgence

name: Individualism vs Collectivism (concept)
expr: individualist cultures prioritize personal goals; collectivist cultures prioritize group goals

name: Berry's Acculturation Strategies (concept)
expr: integration, assimilation, separation, and marginalization

name: HEXACO Model (concept)
expr: Honesty-Humility, Emotionality, eXtraversion, Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, Openness

name: Dark Triad (concept)
expr: narcissism, Machiavellianism, and psychopathy

name: Reciprocal Determinism (concept)
expr: Bandura: behavior, personal factors, and the environment influence each other

name: Self-Discrepancy Theory (concept)
expr: Higgins: gaps between actual, ideal, and ought selves produce negative emotions

name: Allport's Trait Levels (concept)
expr: cardinal, central, and secondary traits

name: Projective Tests (concept)
expr: tests such as the Rorschach and TAT that interpret responses to ambiguous stimuli

name: SMART Goals (concept)
expr: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound

name: Individual Zones of Optimal Functioning (concept)
expr: each athlete has a personal arousal range in which performance is best

name: Borg Rating of Perceived Exertion (concept)
expr: a scale for rating how hard one feels one is working during exercise
